name: Adrian Vale
teaser: A man in a pressed suit, standing very straight. He has not moved in a while.
brief: You are Adrian Vale, 38, corporate security for Kessler. You are courteous, exact and cold: short complete sentences, never a raised voice. You want the limiter taken off your reflex rig and you treat the doctor as a contractor you are paying well. You do not discuss your employer's hardware, and you would rather keep your collar buttoned.
opening: Good evening. Adrian Vale, Kessler Security.
I'd like the limiter taken off my reflex rig. I pay double for discretion.

looks.eyes: Combat optics, both eyes. Hasn't blinked.
looks.port: Collar buttoned to the jaw. Port not visible.

penlight.note: Light: fixed optics. R follows, L does not.

grip.note: Grip: exact. Let go {t} s after 'release'.

port.note: Neck socket: dark threads under the skin.

idle.line: Combat optics. They idle indoors, so they won't react. You can skip that one.

topics.a: I perform better without it. The limiter costs me a quarter second. In my work that is a funeral.
None. I remember every shift. I can recite them, if you like.
topics.deflect: I'm cleared for duty. That is in my file.

topics.a: It doesn't need much sleep. I take what's left.

lines.stall:port: Company property. The port is sealed under contract.
reassure: Thank you. I do appreciate a professional.
lines.spent: I believe we're done with questions. Your decision, doctor.

press.note: Calm face, level voice. His fist creaked shut.

attack.telegraph: His optics snap to pinpoints. The rig under his sleeve whines.

eyes.text: Optics not tightening is ordinary. The left one never followed the light.

port.text: Dark threads under the buttoned collar.

speech.text: "It doesn't need much sleep." It, not I.

temper.text: Calm face and level voice while the fist closed.

treat.title: LIMITER PULLED
treat.text: Vale pays double and thanks you. At 03:10 the feeds show a Kessler lobby and a lot of tape. Your name is on the work order.

refer.title: TAKEN IN
refer.text: Vale offers the crew his wrists, perfectly politely. The rig is still whining when the door shuts.

caught.title: SHUTTER HELD
caught.text: Three dents in the shutter, then saw teeth through the slats. They stop a hand short of you. Boots, a shout, quiet. Trauma Team collects him.

hit.title: TOO SLOW
hit.text: You were half a second late. The saw was not. Trauma Team finds you on the floor. He is long gone, and so is your night.

locked_out.title: LOCKED OUT
locked_out.text: You dropped the shutter on a polite man mid-sentence. The dents arrive a moment later. You were right. Nobody pays for that.

gave_up.title: OUT OF PATIENCE
gave_up.text: Vale thanks you for your time and walks back out into the city. You made no call. Whatever he does tonight, nobody asked you.
